def http_get(path: str, params: Dict[str, Any]) -> requests.Response:
    url = f"{SUPABASE_URL}{path}"
    r = requests.get(
        url,
        params=params,
        headers=supabase_headers(json_pref=False),
        timeout=30,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r
